property_summary: For any locked guess whose target block is in the past and whose blockhash is nonzero, settle() must terminate without reverting when the locked guess does not equal that blockhash; the mutant reverts in this no-op case.
change_summary: Replace the conditional payout guard with a direct require, changing settlement from a possible no-op completion to a revert when the guess does not match.
